top_choice_rationale: P001 gives a single prize to Buchwald and Hartwig for general, ligand-controlled palladium-catalysed C-N cross-coupling. It is a new chemical advance not covered by the 2010 prize, with three decades of independent confirmation, routine use in pharmaceutical and materials synthesis, and the cleanest two-laureate attribution. P002 adds base editing for Liu alone, which is closer to the 2020 CRISPR prize, still maturing clinically, and leaves out Komor and Gaudelli, so it ranks second only because it contains the B052 part. P003 (phase separation) is conceptually broad but its physiological relevance is still disputed and the three-name cap excludes Pappu and Mittag, yet I rank it above no award.
